input_profile.name: NullColumnProfile
derived_fields: missing_class_count = number of non-zero missing class counters

row_inclusion.rule: A data row is included only when at least one header-bounded cell contains a non-missing, non-blank or formula-expression value.
row_inclusion.reason: Prevents trailing empty worksheet rows and formatting-only rows from inflating missingness.

decision_algorithm: Reject the profile when observed_cell_count is zero.
Reject the profile when non_missing_cell_count is zero; that case is reserved for empty-column diagnostics.
Reject the profile when missing_cell_count is zero.
Assign low severity for 0 < missing_ratio < 0.05; medium for 0.05 <= missing_ratio < 0.20; high for missing_ratio >= 0.20.
Set confidence to 0.60 when observed_cell_count < 20; otherwise 0.90. Subtract 0.10 when more than one missing class is present, bounded at 0.50.
Emit counts, ratio and class breakdown as evidence; never emit raw values.
Attach one blocking validation question only when severity is high and observed_cell_count >= 20.
planned_test_matrix: no observed cells produces no finding
all observed cells missing produces no finding
no missing cells produces no finding
one structural null in a large sample produces low severity
20 percent missingness produces high severity and blocking question
small sample produces confidence 0.60 and no blocking question
mixed structural-null and blank-text classes apply confidence penalty
numeric NaN is included in missingness
sentinel and formula expressions are excluded from missing counts
